model_type: Cloud Multimodal Large Vision-Language Model (Google Gemini 3.7 Flash)
deployment_location: Google Cloud / AI Studio API via Node.js backend proxy adapter
privacy_compliance: Tier-dependent. Free Developer API classifies data as Unpaid Services (prompts and images subject to human review and product training), strictly restricted to synthetic testing. Production with real patient health information (PHI) requires Gemini Paid Tier (Zero Data Retention) or Vertex AI with HIPAA Business Associate Agreement (BAA).
on_device_binary_size_impact: 0 MB mobile bundle overhead. Network calls routed entirely through backend server proxy; client remains lightweight React Native/Expo app.
printed_label_accuracy: Very High (94-98% field-level accuracy). Accurately parses dense packaging, pharmaceutical warnings, micro-typography, and non-standard generic/brand hierarchy.
handwriting_recognition: High (78-88% accuracy on messy doctor prescriptions, Rx sigs, Latin abbreviations like q8h, bid, prn, and non-standard physician handwriting).
multilingual_code_switching_support: Superior. Native multilingual semantic understanding seamlessly interprets Tagalog/Filipino instructions ('kalahating tableta', 'tuwing gabi bago matulog', 'pagkatapos kumain ng almusal') without requiring custom regex dictionaries.
curved_surface_and_glare_tolerance: High. Visual attention mechanisms compensate for cylindrical bottle curvature distortion and read through specular reflections on metallic blister strips.
tabular_timetable_parsing: Excellent. End-to-end 2D spatial visual transformer preserves row/column relationships in multi-dose hospital discharge sheets and columnar timetables without crosstalk.
hallucination_under_degraded_input: Moderate-to-High risk if unconstrained. Under severe tear, blur, or glare, generative decoder can invent plausible medication names or standard dosages. Mitigated by setting temperature=0, enforcing schema nullability, and mandating formulary grounding.
latency_seconds: 1.2 to 2.8 seconds end-to-end API response time over standard broadband or 4G LTE mobile connection.
ram_peak_footprint: Negligible (<10 MB) on Node.js backend proxy. 0 MB client footprint on caregiver mobile devices.
cost_profile: Free tier available on Google AI Studio with variable rate limits (RPM/TPD/RPD) for synthetic prototyping. Paid tier charges approximately $0.10 / 1M input tokens and $0.40 / 1M output tokens (roughly $0.0003 per prescription image).
react_native_compatibility: Fully compatible via Alaga's Node.js backend proxy (POST /medications/ocr-draft). Keeps secret API keys out of client bundle and maintains Expo SDK 57 compatibility.
offline_readiness: Zero offline capability. Requires continuous active internet connection (LTE/Wi-Fi) to reach Google API endpoints; non-functional in disconnected rural clinics.
structured_output_support: Native JSON Schema structured output enforcement via responseSchema. Guaranteed deterministic adherence to Alaga's MedicationOcrDraft interface without intermediate regex parsers.
formulary_grounding_readiness: High. Extracted canonical text tokens are clean, separated into genericName and brandName, enabling direct deterministic lookup against Philippine National Drug Formulary (PNDF).
